name: thundernotes
description: ThunderNotes - a fast local notes manager living inside a Thunderbird Space.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "build/test/*.test.js"
scripts.xpi: npm run build && node scripts/build.mjs --xpi && npm run verify:xpi
scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/build.mjs --xpi && npm run verify:xpi
